_why_no_titles: Round 17 cut the burnt-in headlines. They were pixels in a video: they could not reflow on a phone, could not be selected or read aloud, and were baked at one size, and while they were there the page had to keep clear of them. The studio's claim is now type on the screen's floor (ui/screen.js, .screen-line). The lines that were here: Nothing here / was filmed.; Pick the / camera move.; One take flies / into the next.; Made with / open weights.; Every take / keeps a receipt.
